comment: Per-site inputs for render_showcase.py. Everything else about the render, cameras included, is derived from the artifacts at run time.

defaults.fishnet_lift_note: The fishnet was cut against an earlier build of the same tiles and sits up to 0.4 m off the double-precision support mesh drawn here. Displacing the semantic layer along the line of sight of the camera that produced it is the one direction that cannot invent an occlusion.

render.flat_world_note: Linear light, not display sRGB. It only reaches the background: the categorical layers are pure emitters.

outline.note: Freestyle silhouette, border and crease lines over the flat categorical layers. They restore the geometric form that a pure emitter has none of, and they only touch the pixels on the line, so the interior of every class is still exactly its legend colour.

korenmarkt.title: Korenmarkt, Ghent
korenmarkt.tiles_note: Rebuild with download_inhouse_tiles.py --lat 51.055 --lon 3.722 --radius-m 200 --geometric-error-cutoff-m 0 if this cache is gone. GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY must be set.

milan_duomo.title: Piazza del Duomo, Milan
milan_duomo.texture_evidence_note: build_texture_evidence.py has not been run at this site, so the visibility view has two states rather than three.
milan_duomo.bodies_note: infer_sam3_body.py and build_dynamic_bodies.py have not been run at this site.
milan_duomo.tiles_note: Rebuild with download_inhouse_tiles.py --lat 45.4642 --lon 9.19 --radius-m 320 --geometric-error-cutoff-m 0 if this cache is gone.
